description: Use to check whether cached Strong Saga gear data is still current, or when a user asks what is new. Returns each data refresh newest first: products added or removed (ids), prices added or changed, guide ranks changed, guides updated, fields added, with the UTC time and API version. Built only from this API's own refresh history. Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD) for refreshes after a date, or id for one product.

id.description: Only refreshes that touched this product id, e.g. sg-001.

since.description: Only refreshes at or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or UTC time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

name: get_gear_changes
title: What changed in the gear data
